\caption{Application, Earth observation data source and temporal property for
\nSTDrawn{} of the \nSpanReported{} studies that report a date range (the rest
use very-high-resolution imagery only, or name no sensor). Ribbon width is
proportional to the number of studies: each study contributes unit weight,
divided equally among the data sources it uses, and ribbons are colored by
application. Very-high-resolution satellite and aerial imagery is excluded
because it supplies spatial detail rather than a temporal signal. SAR comprises
Sentinel-1, ERS-1/2, Envisat ASAR; the coarse-resolution series are AVHRR, DMSP/OLS, MODIS, SMAP, SMOS, VIIRS. The temporal property is assigned
per data source rather than extracted from the studies.}
